expires_today.title: C++ Programming Masterclass: Code Faster. Build Smarter. Master C++

expires_tomorrow.title: Game Dev Mega Cities

expires_tomorrow.title: Crochet Bags and Wearables by Open Road Media
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Fill your closet with crochet wearables with this library of craft ebooks from Open Road Media! This collection of crochet patterns and inspiration includes 29 books with ideas for basically everything—from shawls, hats, handbags, and adorable animal slippers to southwest-inspired blankets and cozy cardigans. If you’re intimidated by any of the more complex patterns, there are also plenty of simple projects for beginners you can finish in a few hours! Next time you need some inspiration for an ambitious project or just something to do with your hands in your idle time, let these crochet books be your guide! Get all 29 books for the price of your choice, and support the Breast Cancer Research Foundation with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Backrooms and Liminal World Builder Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Calling all prospective filmmakers! Create effortlessly with the Backrooms Pro Generator or the Procedural Backrooms Generator, with four architectural styles, customizable sliders, and no modeling required! Plus, your purchase helps support Trees, Water & People!
